# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m155 with GLES interop and HarfBuzz refreshes. The release also disables RAW and DNG image decoding and incorporates upstream m155 servicing fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **RAW and DNG image decoding disabled** — RAW and DNG images are no longer decoded by the bundled engine. Use another decoder or convert those images before loading them with SkiaSharp. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m155** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m155 and incorporates the current upstream bug and servicing fixes. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196), [#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — Updates the managed GLES interop surface to use pointer-based signatures for native interoperability. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and managed binding to version 14.4.0.
